remarks: Discover a sophisticated lifestyle in this beautiful 10th floor one bedroom condo. South east facing sun-filled living spaces features an open concept living/dining area, crown molding, and wood-look flooring that sets an elevated tone throughout. Kitchen is bright and airy and features modern cabinetry. The serene oversized bedroom offers comfort and convenience. Marble bathroom also impresses with clean contemporary finishes. A large private balcony extends your living area outdoors, where wide angle skyline views provide the perfect backdrop overlooking Stamford watching the seasons change while you unwind at the end of each day. Additional storage is plentiful thanks to multiple oversized closets throughout the home. Residents enjoy a robust lineup of lifestyle amenities including an outdoor pool, fitness center, community room, playground, reserved parking, secure gatehouse entry with security guard, and private storage. Monthly HOA fees cover heat, hot water, cooking gas, and basic cable, delivering exceptional value. Situated steps from Tully Health Center and minutes from Downtown Stand, major highways, public transportation, shops, and restaurants, this home blends luxury and everyday convenience - your ideal downtown retreat awaits.
